description: Real-time Watchlist Mode: Introduce WebSocket streaming via yfinance's AsyncWebSocket to enable live price updates for the watchlist. This is an exploratory feature to validate streaming architecture before potentially expanding to charts.
principles: EXPLORATORY AND INCREMENTAL - Prove the concept before expanding scope
STABILITY AND PERFORMANCE ARE PARAMOUNT - Streaming must not degrade app responsiveness
Graceful degradation - polling remains the reliable fallback
Connection resilience - handle disconnects, reconnects, and errors gracefully
Minimal invasive changes - streaming is opt-in, not a replacement
Rock-solid quality over speed - every change must be bulletproof
Comprehensive test coverage - unit tests, integration tests, edge cases
If in doubt, keep it simple
